_comment: Copy this file to config.json and edit. Each 'watch' is one Craigslist search to poll repeatedly. The safest way to get a URL is to go to https://chicago.craigslist.org, use the search box and category filters yourself, then copy the resulting URL from your browser's address bar into 'url' below -- that guarantees it matches what Craigslist actually serves today. The URLs below are reasonable starting points but Craigslist changes category codes occasionally, so verify them in a browser before relying on them.

watches.name: Property management - services offered (small biz ads)
